## Workload

Hannah Lowe graded 580 sets during 278 rostered hours. This equates to 2.1 sets per hour and provides a clear measure of the workload completed during the review period. The recorded output was considered alongside the time available for grading, ensuring that the assessment reflected both volume and pace. The workload information supports a consistent basis for reviewing the grader’s overall performance.

## Quality

A sample of 41 sets was read again to assess the consistency of the grading. The agreement result was 51.2. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases, with these cases identified as requiring particular care and attention during review. The findings were considered by Priya Anand, reviewer, who completed the review of the work undertaken by Hannah Lowe.
